features: [High Quality & Toughness Enhanced] - Numakers premium PLA filament is produced using USA sourced high-quality PLA resin developed specifically for 3D printer filament. Compared to other PLA filaments, Numakers PLA filament has excellent printability as well as improved impact resistance in printed parts.

[Easy-to-Use, Clog-Free, Bubble-Free] - Special precision oscillating strand guide technology guarantees tidy and tangle-free winding. Filaments are dried before packaging to ensure a smooth and stable printing experience.

[Wide Compatibility] - 1.75mm PLA filament compatible with practically all desktop 3D printers, including Makerbot, Monoprice, Ender 3, Airwolf, Ultimaker, Makergear, Lutzbot, Flashforge and many more.
[Dimension Accuracy & Consistency] - Fully automated closed-loop diameter measuring and self-adaptive control system in the manufacturing process ensures strict diameter tolerance of +/- 0.03 mm.
[Wallet Friendly] - Economies of scale and improved production efficiency allows NUMAKERS filament to be cost-effective and wallet-friendly without compromising on quality.
